name: Uzura
source:
She is a young girl working as a maid at Tsurunoya. She stands at 4'5" (~138cm). She is very fond of Ennosuke who is not much older than her but holds a full-fledged job. 

She wants to help him in any way she can. She sometimes looks like she's making a point but always comes up with weird explanations.

She wants to become a fully-fledged Oiran, but she lacks the experience and has a long way to go. In addition to being a live in maid, she is a Kamuro, a servant to a high class courtesan. She trains diligently to become a high-class courtesan herself.

She is also in charge of taking care of Yozuru's personal needs.
